verdict.rationale: Sentry documents OTLP ingestion of OpenTelemetry traces and logs, either directly from an OTel SDK or through the OpenTelemetry Collector. That lets OTel-instrumented code point at Sentry or another backend through configuration rather than re-instrumentation. However, the evidence covers only traces and logs. Sentry's core error monitoring and its other features are shown via its own SDK, so the open-standards path appears to cover only part of the product. missing for 10: OTLP metrics ingestion, documentation that errors and other native features work from OTel-only instrumentation, feature-parity details versus the native SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of switching backends.
